profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at SPS Commerce
profile.summary: Highly motivated Software Engineer and graduate of the Full-Stack Web Development Bootcamp with the University of Minnesota. Skilled in React, JavaScript, Java, SQL and databases, with hands-on experience building and debugging applications. Passionate about seeing creative ideas come to life through code.  Has a demonstrated history of strong organizational skills, time management skills, attention to detail, and teamwork experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop large-scale features, each spanning multiple applications and requiring collaboration across the team 
- Work with Product and UX/UI Designers to architect and design new features, providing detailed design documents
- Took on the role of team Scrum Master, leading daily, weekly and monthly sprint ceremonies as well as managing Jira sprint boards
- Demo new features to VPs and key stakeholders

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Took ownership of a long-awaited customer-facing feature and collaborated across teams to ensure its success
- Helped to convert an old AngularJS application to React
- Contributed components to a centralized UI component library used by multiple teams
- Participated in new-hire interviews

positions.title: Full Stack Web Development Student
positions.description:
· Full-time web development bootcamp. 
· Learned MERN stack, as well as HTML, JavaScript, jQuery, python, MySQL, and git. 
· Earned Full Stack Web Development Certificate.

positions.title: Support Coordinator
positions.description:
•   Managed administrative logistics of events planning, including fee collection, event booking, and event promotions.
•   Selected and ordered event materials and swag items.
•   Provided general support to a variety of departments, including sales, marketing, QA, and regulatory.

positions.title: Commercial and Fleet Sales Consultant
positions.description:
•   Provided repeat customers with exceptional care and attention.
•   Produced contracts, quotes, and proposals for clients.
•   Responded to formal Government bids for goods/services.
•   Asked appropriate open-ended questions to discover client’s needs and product requirements.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
• Handled multiple projects simultaneously and displayed a solid reputation for meeting project time lines.
• Provided daily support to a staff of sales professionals to prepare quotes and place orders.
• Partnered directly with business leaders to complete paperwork, filing, invoicing, and data entry.
• Coordinated closely with vendors and customers to check order status and schedule deliveries.
• Completed preliminary reports for sales monthly.
• Answered telephones, helped and/or directed customers to the correct salesperson.

positions.title: Zookeeper
positions.description:
•   Indirectly managed a team of 5+ individuals as “keeper in charge”.
•   Responsible for assisting with the on boarding of 5+ individuals.
•   Partnered with the lead keeper to establish weekly objectives and complete all projects on time.

honors.title: Summa Cum Laude
honors.issuer: Issued by North Dakota State University · Jan 2013

projects.title: Shreddit
projects.description:
Shreddit is an in-browser application that allows users to create melodies in the Shreddit Studio and share them with the world! 
Comment on Shreds to let users know what you think, vote up or down for your favorite Shreds, check out your User page to find all of the Shreds that you have created, and go to other User pages to see their Shreds.

projects.title: Settle-It!
projects.description: Settle It! is a web application where you post an issue and describe why you support or do not support your issue. You then invite a user of the app to respond or vote on your issue. Other users can vote for one side that they support.
